description.text: Main Courses Thiscourse includes the fundamental principles of biochemistry, genetics, molecular biology, and cell biology. Biological function at the molecular level is particularly emphasized and covers the structure and regulation of genes, as well as, the structure and synthesis of proteins, how these molecules are integrated into cells, and how these cells are integrated into multicellular systems and organisms. In addition, each version of the subject has its own distinctive material. Degree Awarded On completing the requirements of the teaching program and passing the graduation examinations successfully, international medical graduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by HuaZhong University of Science and Technoligy, if they meet the degree regulations of HuaZhong University of Science and Technoligy. The English copy of the degree will stateDoctor's degree. Career After obtainingDoctor's Degree, the graduates can apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council in order to get registered and practice medicine. According to the regulations in different countries, the students may need to do the degree accreditation first. A Doctor's degree holder can find jobs in government as well as private hospitals, nursing homes and other health facilities.

duration.text: The Immunology at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate Level 6 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. photocopy of awards certificate If applicable 8. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.

requirements.text: 1. Have obtained Master's Degree 2. Be in good health 3. Be under the age of 40 4. Good command of English
